answer_1.quote: we conduct extensive experiments on three representative LLMs across different sizes, covering six shortform and long-form factual question-answering (QA) datasets.
answer_1.outputs: Generated factual answers to QA prompts (short-form and long-form)

answer_2.quote: In the short-form QA task, we leverage accuracy (Acc.) to measure the extent of LLM hallucinations... For the long-form QA task... we report the number of correct claims averaged per question (# Correct) and the FActScore... For LongFact, we ... reporting precision (Prec.), recall (R@48), and F1 score (F1@48).

answer_3.quote: we adopt Llama-3.1-70B, one of the most powerful open-source models, as the grader... we first utilize Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct for atomic facts decomposition... we employ retrieval+llama+npm as the evaluator due to its strong correlation with human judgment.
